name: Slow Walk
description: 5 min, average speed must stay below 2.5 km/h (warn at 3, penalty at 4)

name: Single File
description: 5 min, team must walk in a single file; app prompts twice for group photo from the front

name: Photo Tax
description: 8 min, selfie at any sign every 90 s

name: Check-in
description: 10 min, captain must answer in-app prompts every minute (auto-locks captain actions on miss)

name: Detour
description: 15 min, banned from one named street (random); auto-flagged on entry

name: Buddy Up
description: 15 min, all team members within 10 m of each other

name: Outfit Swap
description: must swap one item of clothing with a teammate, keep it for 20 min; before/after photos

name: Mute
description: 15 min, may only communicate by typing in the app; app pings "still muted? ✓" each minute

name: Backwards
description: 10 min, must walk facing backwards (a teammate may guide); honor only

name: Pose Patrol
description: 12 min, every 2 min the app sends a pose ("hands on head") that must be photographed within 30 s

name: Frozen
description: 8 min, all team members stay within 10 m of position at curse start

name: Pilgrimage
description: must walk to a specific neutral landmark before any other action; geofence-gated

name: Solo Quarantine
description: 15 min, team members must each be at least 50 m apart

name: Full Stop
description: 10 min, no app actions allowed (no purchases, no tags, no challenge submissions)
